_comment: Factory-wide defaults — true for EVERY project. Per-project run.json overrides only what differs. This file is what makes project #2 nearly free.
_starter: Your hardened fork is the default starter for every project. PIN starter_ref to a TAG once the branch stabilises — a moving branch means two runs a week apart are not the same experiment.
_workspace: Omit to use the default: a 'projects' directory alongside the project-factory repo. Override here, or per-invocation with PROJECT_FACTORY_WORKSPACE / --workspace.
_ports: api/web run as local processes (the starter ships no Dockerfiles). Ports auto-increment if busy, so parallel projects do not collide.
_checkpoint: LangGraph checkpoints — our own Postgres on 5433, separate from every project DB.
_budget: Circuit breaker per run. Measured cost is reported at Gate C — that number is what replaces guesswork.
_dev: keep_stack_running leaves api+web up after a run so you can click through the app (sign in as john.doe@example.com). keep_db leaves Postgres up for pnpm db:studio.
